question.en: Discuss the evolution of the global trade regime from GATT to the WTO. How did this transition impact the Indian economy?
question.hi: Discuss the evolution of the global trade regime from GATT to the WTO. How did this transition impact the Indian economy?

introduction.en: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was established in 1947 to promote international trade. It served as the primary framework for global trade until the establishment of the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 1995.
introduction.hi: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was established in 1947 to promote international trade. It served as the primary framework for global trade until the establishment of the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 1995.

body.en: The transition from GATT to WTO marked a shift from a provisional agreement to a permanent, rule-based organization. The Uruguay Round expanded the scope to include services (GATS) and intellectual property (TRIPS). For India, this transition meant greater market access but also stricter compliance with global standards, impacting sectors like agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and services.
body.hi: The transition from GATT to WTO marked a shift from a provisional agreement to a permanent, rule-based organization. The Uruguay Round expanded the scope to include services (GATS) and intellectual property (TRIPS). For India, this transition meant greater market access but also stricter compliance with global standards, impacting sectors like agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and services.

conclusion.en: While the transition brought challenges in terms of policy space, it integrated India into the global economy, fostering growth in the services sector and enhancing export competitiveness.
